An amoral, racist, misogynist, megalomaniac, wealthy elite far removed from the highly touted "Common Man".  Now placed in the position of head of the Gestapo to advise and carry out every fascist program of the new Hitler, containing the same adjectives.  The death of a nation.

"We don't treat women for that", or "Your line is over there", or "AlaskaCare isn't paying enough for piles in Oklahoma 'cause you been sitting too long. The 'Spaceball' possibilities are endless.
Our Alaska Senators, yes BOTH of you Dan, need to call this the stupid, stupid that it is . 
Unless you are too stupid! This was invented by the Un-United States Senators.for whatever re-election.
I remember going to a clinic in Florida who refused to treat me because-- you fill in the rest of the story!

It's funny how those who only read/see the news are so quick to judge. Were you there when it happened? Do you know the full story? Everything that you read nowadays is one-sided. Get your facts straight before judging or else you've become like every other dumb idiots trying to push for peace and equality but in reality you are the ones with the most hatred. How do you even know it was a hate crime? What if it was the victims way of not manning up to his actions, it was a stupid fight between two grown men. No one should ever pull the race, gender, religion card to take away someone else's freedom. I'm not saying he shouldn't be punished for his actions but make sure you know for a fact that was the only reason they fought. The judicial system is corrupted. It's all about money and politics.

"He treats women like dogs, and you go against everything I — and other female conservatives — said you were & back down like cowards.

I’m sooo done. If you can’t stand up for women & unendorse this piece of human garbage, you deserve every charge of sexism thrown at you.

I’m just one woman, you won’t even notice my lack of presence at rallies, fair booths, etc., You won’t really care that I’m offended by your silence, and your inability to take a stand. But one by one you’ll watch more women like me go, & you’ll watch men of ACTUAL character follow us out the door. And what you’ll be left with are the corrupt masses that foam at the mouth every time you step outside the lines. Men who truly see women as lesser beings, & women without self-respect. & your “guiding faith” & “principles” will be attached to them as well. And when it’s all said and done, all you’ll have left is the party The Left always accused you of being. Scum."
